component.name: Community Lab IDE
component.summary: An IDE for actuarial agent-based simulation

description.p: Community Lab IDE is a desktop IDE for actuarial agent-based simulation. Unity Province is three cities, a centre and an airport, where every one of about four hundred residents is an agent living on published South African mortality and fertility bases. Every rand is posted to hash-chained double-entry books, a burial society carries the risk, and the analytics measure actual against expected experience.

A workbench keeps provinces, paired experiments and scripts as files in a folder: run a province on a new basis, put an experiment on the local worker pool with common random numbers and 95% intervals, or script the engine directly. It runs offline; a local model scripts the conversations.

The first release of Community Lab IDE as an application of its own, independent of Scelo IDE and the swarm. The province, its analytics, the actuarial workbench and the policy and stress lab, with a new workbench of files: provinces, experiments and scripts in a folder you choose, an editor that knows their shapes, a console, and a run for each. Exports save to the workspace or to disk, and a mortality table can be imported from CSV to live the province on.
